svg.aria-label: Decision press: an n8n agent console (left) feeds one input from its hopper down the cable into Google's Decisions API press — the lit decision die scores up to 1,000 closed-set questions in a single forward pass on the scoring bed. Three dials read the question types (noul, choice, score); the confidence gauge reads 0.94 on this pass, so the routing lever throws the winning route to the lit ACT cell while the dimmed REVIEW cell waits for human review. Verified numbers (Google, Nov 11, 2026): 1,000 questions in one pass, 150-250 ms end-to-end, $0.10 per 1M input tokens, $0 output tokens, 256K-token input, 3 question types.
svg.text: 1,000 questions · one pass · 150–250 ms · $0.10/1M in · $0 out · 256K in
